allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/session" -Method GET -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "STATUS:$\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output "BODY:$\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { Write-Output "STATUS: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } })
